items.problem: VsToggleButton and VideoButton anchored HorizontalAlignment=Right land at x=1248 in a 1280-wide window and are clipped at the right edge.
items.evidence: discrepancies.json layout item; MainPage.xaml StackPanel HorizontalAlignment=Right (line 52).
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md migrate-in-place rule (lines 8, 179-182) — preserve the source layout verbatim. The migrated XAML faithfully reproduces the UWP edge-anchored StackPanel; the original UWP golden also places these buttons at the right edge (baseline screenshot).
items.why_no_skill_change: The clipping is a per-pixel, scenario-specific window-sizing artifact of an edge-anchored overlay, not a recurring skill rule. The migration preserved the source layout faithfully (which the skill requires); inventing a general 'add margins to edge-anchored controls' rule would over-fit and risk altering faithful layouts elsewhere. The real, general fix is the visible-placeholder change, which fills the page center so a clipped overlay no longer leaves the page blank.
